Sentence: On Mercury, + a solar day takes + two full orbits around the Sun

Now, when we say a day is twice as long as a year, we're actually talking about a "solar day" which is how long it takes to go from one sunrise to the next. After one full orbit around the Sun, because of how fast Mercury moves relative to it's spin, it's only just facing away from the sun now, meaning it takes two full years to see the sun in the same position in the sky!

Khalid underestimated British Royal Navy and within 5 minutes they had all their defences wiped out, the palace ablaze and flattened in an hour.
